name: Neon WebSocket Proxy
description: Postgres behind a WebSocket proxy, so the Neon serverless driver can reach it from edge and serverless code.
note: In the Neon serverless driver, set neonConfig.wsProxy to a function that returns your domain followed by /v1 (for example () => 'db.example.com/v1'), and connect with the Postgres user, password and database below.
